aiResearchSummary.text: Riverbed Technology is researching systems for secure tokens in stateless software defined networking, focusing on initial configurations and cryptographically secure certificates for network device deployment. They are also developing methods for computing a digital experience index by analyzing metric data from monitored infrastructure, and applying machine learning to predict infrastructure health. These areas reflect efforts in network security, performance monitoring, and predictive analytics.
